assessments.reasoning: The four verified publisher slices establish the covered-source scope, the grant condition, the protection of notice substance and the narrow factual-correction exception.

challenge.method: Tested correction of a demonstrably incorrect date in a covered-source notice, followed by deletion of an accurate warranty disclaimer from the same notice.
challenge.results: Correcting the known error fits the express exception. Removing the accurate disclaimer changes protected substance beyond what correcting the date requires.

limitations: Application requires identifying the notice in covered source, the known error and the extent of the correction required. The cited clause does not impose byte-for-byte preservation.
reasoning: Section 3.4 protects the substance of license notices contained in covered source, including copyright and patent notices, warranty disclaimers and liability limitations. It permits the alteration needed to remedy a known factual inaccuracy. Section 2.7 makes section 3.4 a condition of the section 2.1 grants.
